build_mobileone_backbone: build a MobileOne backbone model with architecture s0 and extract feature maps from all stages
create_mobileone_block: create a MobileOneBlock with configurable conv branches, SE layers, and batch normalization for feature extraction
switch_to_deploy_mode: switch a trained MobileOne model from training mode to deployment mode by fusing conv and BN parameters
reparameterize_mobileone_block: reparameterize a MobileOneBlock by fusing all branch weights and biases into a single convolution layer
freeze_mobileone_stages: freeze specified stages of a MobileOne backbone to prevent gradient updates during fine-tuning
